purpose: Teach: 侵攻/搾取/転落/談話/快楽/湾岸/丸山/セックス

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ウィルスの侵攻に医療チームは備えております
lines.en: Ren, our medical team is prepared for the virus outbreak.
lines.style: Measured, professional delivery. Steady eye contact. The certainty of someone who has briefed this team thoroughly. No hesitation. Slight pause before the period—composure held.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 労働者の医療搾取は許されません、貴院も同感ですね、先生
lines.en: So healthcare workers shouldn't be exploited. Your hospital agrees with that, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Careful, genuinely curious phrasing—testing the waters slightly. Soft, thoughtful rhythm. Leaning forward a little with interest, not challenge. The thoughtfulness of someone working through something out loud.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、転落事故の救急対応を医療チームは強化しております
lines.en: Yes, we've also strengthened our emergency response protocols for trauma cases.
lines.style: Even tone, professional clarity. Each fact placed with deliberate care. Quiet authority without strain. The rhythm of someone used to delivering important information with precision and calm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医師会の談話、貴院、ご賛同なんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital is supporting the medical association's statement on this. That's good to know.
lines.style: Gentle confirmation in the voice. Not quite a question—more a quiet reflection that invites agreement. Ren pauses to absorb, then nods slightly with understanding. Warm but reserved.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、快楽追求型の薬物乱用に医療チームは警告しております
lines.en: Yes, we've issued warnings to our team about substance abuse and addiction issues.
lines.style: Direct but not stern. The clarity of necessary caution. Professional distance maintained but with underlying concern for patient welfare. Slight weight on 'warnings'—it matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 湾岸地域の医療派遣に貴院も参加されたんですね、先生
lines.en: And your hospital is participating in the medical dispatch program for coastal areas too, then.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation in the voice—piecing together a larger picture of the hospital's commitments. Ren speaks with gentle approval, almost to himself. No judgment, just recognition of the scope of their work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、丸山先生のご講演を医療チームで拝聴しました
lines.en: Yes, our team attended Dr. Maruyama's recent lecture on the topic.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact confirmation. Professional reference to a peer's contribution. Delivered with the respect due to a colleague's expertise. Unbothered, factual—this is routine for them.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、セックスカウンセリングも開設されているそうですね、先生
lines.en: I understand your hospital has also opened a counseling service for that as well.
lines.style: Final reflection, spoken gently and almost rhetorically. Ren's voice carries quiet respect for the breadth of the hospital's care. A slight fadeout—acknowledgment more than question. Warm closure.
